name: Marui Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Marui Group Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the retailing and fintech businesses in Japan. The company engages in the rental and management of commercial facilities; purchase and sales of clothing and decorative goods, spatial design, advertising, and promotion; investment trust sales, software development, and computer operations, as well as fashion logistics and building management, short-term insurance, trucking, cargo handling, and advertising businesses.
